findings.source_quote: He decided to go, but just not today.
findings.translation_quote: Akaamua kwenda, lakini si leo tu.

findings.source_quote: It all seemed so clear! He wept as he broke.
findings.suggested_fix: Yote yalionekana wazi kabisa! Alilia alipovunjika moyo.
findings.translation_quote: Yote yakawa wazi sana! Alilia moyo wake ulipovunjika.

findings.source_quote: He could hardly wait, to be who God made him to be.
findings.suggested_fix: Hakuweza kusubiri kuwa yule ambaye Mungu alikusudia awe.
findings.translation_quote: Hakuweza kusubiri kuwa vile Mungu alivyomuumba awe.
